statements.notes: Server methods answer the ERROR: texts; the SQL functions raise (SQLCODE -149 wrapping -400 with the ERROR: text; the IVG 5001 code itself is not in the driver's message).

statements.text: A call to the Arno library over SQL raises a library error when the library is missing or the function name is unknown. It does the same for a wrong count of arguments, or for an answer that is an error. A long answer is fetched in parts.
statements.dependency: an x86_64 libarno_callout.so 1.2.1 loadable by the audit IRIS (F-1001; versions/AVAILABILITY.md, run ver-arno-callout)
live_cases: arno_call unknown function name, library missing
statements.notes: Only the library-missing branch is reachable here and holds live (rx-live-10: arno_call raises ArnoError 'libarno_callout not available', for a known and an unknown kernel name; the unknown-name, arity, NULL/ERROR-answer and chunked-fetch branches run only after arno_available() is True). The first call wrote ^IVG.Deploy("routines") once (the wrappers' routine record, arno_bridge.py:360-376), allowed for that case.
